name: mirage
text: Yes to both. Other score sources exist: BoltOdds' /livescores accepted a subscription on your key, but the app has never read what it sends, and SX Bet has a public /live-scores route. Neither is wired in, so the model line on the Live board only has ESPN, and an MLB game ESPN doesn't list (the Cleveland game in your screenshot) can't be scored. Comparing Novig to live odds from other sockets already exists. BoltOdds' soft-book consensus feeds the live lane, with a 4% edge floor because it has no sharp book, and Kalshi and SX Bet are priced the same way. The 'model is only 46.5% sure' lines come from the score-based model, which is separate from that. I wrote it down as CH29: first read BoltOdds and SX scores behind ESPN, then show on the Live board which games are priced by the sockets and which by the score model. I haven't built either yet.
